title: Queue pause reasons: test the typed-kind wiring from real Claude and Codex signals, persisted reload and promotion rollback
outcome: Queue pause reasons: test the typed-kind wiring from real Claude and Codex signals, persisted reload and promotion rollback
acceptance: Behaviour tests show: a Claude result frame with a numeric api_error_status and a Codex terminal failure with codexErrorInfo each yield the matching failureKind on the pause; a paused session's reason survives a persisted reload and is dropped when the reloaded pause is not an ordinary one; and a queue-promotion rollback restores the reason it captured.
